item_short_desc: Experience unparalleled clarity and durability with Rothco's 7 x 50MM Binoculars. These binoculars are designed to withstand the harshest environments with their waterproof and fog-proof construction. The buoyant design ensures they float if accidentally dropped in water, and they are O-ring sealed and nitrogen-filled for ultimate protection against moisture. With a 7X magnification and a 132m field of view at 1000m, you can easily spot distant objects.
description: Experience unparalleled clarity and durability with Rothco's 7 x 50MM Binoculars. These binoculars are designed to withstand the harshest environments with their waterproof and fog-proof construction. The buoyant design ensures they float if accidentally dropped in water, and they are O-ring sealed and nitrogen-filled for ultimate protection against moisture. With a 7X magnification and a 132m field of view at 1000m, you can easily spot distant objects. The multi-coated lenses provide enhanced light transmission for brighter images. Additional features include a built-in compass, range finder, and illumination reading for precise navigation. The binoculars come with a carrying case, cleaning cloth, and 2 CX936 batteries, making them perfect for all your outdoor adventures.
